policy: Build directly from exact upstream Git releases selected in dependencies/lock.json; explicitly check upstream before a new experiment generation.

lichess.bridge: A separate lichess-bot bridge is optional; no Refactor Bot API or UCI product route is implemented by this tool installer.

syzygy.selection: Explicit manifest of material coverage, file sizes and SHA-256; selected data must be acquired independently.

capability_boundary: Installed and probed external tools do not implement or activate the native Laplace chess forward pass, UCI product adapter, PGN admission or Lichess Bot API orchestration.
